mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates increase the cost of capital and reduce corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which often precedes a downturn in economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which is typically associated with positive economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months signals a disinflationary environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real earnings growth improves.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% in a month and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also decline, it indicates a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% and RSAFS declines in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST declines by more than 10% and RSAFS also declines.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% in a month and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, it signals a supportive monetary policy for supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% and FEDFUNDS is below 3%.
